name: Caramel-Macadamia Nut Cheesecake Tart (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: The cheesecake filling is smooth, but the topping is encrusted with crunchy roasted macadamia nut chunks.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Scrape off the entire macadamia nut crust on top and eat only the smooth cheesecake interior with a Lactaid.
